cold_start: Take one breath. Who are you about to stand before?
Leave what is in your hands. Stand fully present.
This moment is between you and Allah.
Set everything down. This is your time.
The world can wait. This cannot.
You are about to stand before the Most High. Arrive fully.

work.attributeTranslation: The Trustee, The Disposer of Affairs
work.emerging: You've sometimes noticed thoughts of work drifting into this Salah.
work.established: Your work concerns often arise at this time. Stand before Al-Wakeel — entrust your affairs to the One who manages all things.

financial.emerging: You've occasionally noticed thoughts of provision during this Salah.
financial.established: Financial pressure often visits this Salah. Stand before Ar-Razzaq — the One who controls all provision.

family.emerging: Thoughts of family or relationships have sometimes come during this Salah.
family.established: Family and relationship concerns often come to this prayer. Stand before Al-Wadud — the source of all love and care.

anxiety.emerging: You've sometimes noticed anxiety about the future in this Salah.
anxiety.established: Worry about the future often accompanies this prayer. Stand before Al-Hafeez — the One who preserves and protects all things.

fatigue.emerging: You've noted tiredness during this Salah at times.
fatigue.established: Fatigue is often present at this time. Stand before Al-Qadir — draw from the strength of the One who has power over all things.

physical.emerging: Physical discomfort has occasionally distracted you in this Salah.
physical.established: Physical discomfort often arises during this prayer. Turn to Ash-Shaafi — the One who heals and restores.

random.emerging: Your mind has sometimes wandered to random thoughts in this Salah.
random.established: Random thoughts often visit this prayer. Remember Al-Aleem — He who knows every secret and sees every turn of the heart.

other.emerging: You've sometimes noticed your attention drifting during this Salah.
other.established: Your attention sometimes drifts at this time. Stand before Al-Mujeeb — He who responds to every call and hears every whisper.
